description: Angular component for managing JavaScript resources in the Thingsboard platform, including form handling, resource subtype switching, and file upload.

classes.name: JsResourceComponent
classes.description: Angular component for editing and managing JavaScript resources, supporting subtype switching, form validation, and file handling.

methods.name: ngOnInit
methods.description: Initializes the component, sets up resource subtype change observation if adding a new resource.

methods.name: ngOnDestroy
methods.description: Cleans up subscriptions when the component is destroyed.

methods.name: hideDelete
methods.description: Determines if the delete option should be hidden based on configuration.

methods.name: buildForm
methods.description: Constructs the reactive form for resource data entry.

methods.name: updateForm
methods.description: Updates the form with resource data.

methods.name: updateFormState
methods.description: Overrides base method to disable resource subtype field during editing.

methods.name: prepareFormValue
methods.description: Prepares the form data for submission, including file creation for module resources.

methods.name: getAllowedExtensions
methods.description: Returns allowed file extensions for JS modules.

methods.name: getAcceptType
methods.description: Returns MIME types accepted for JS module files.

methods.name: convertToBase64File
methods.description: Converts string data to base64 format.

methods.name: onResourceIdCopied
methods.description: Displays notification when resource ID is copied.

methods.name: uploadContentFromFile
methods.description: Handles uploading content from a file into the form.

methods.name: observeResourceSubTypeChange
methods.description: Sets up subscription to resource subtype changes.

methods.name: onResourceSubTypeChange
methods.description: Handles changes in resource subtype, updating form fields accordingly.

methods.name: updateResourceSubTypeFieldsState
methods.description: Enables or disables form fields based on resource subtype.
